description: New Zealand Active Faults Database is a database run by GNS Science (Earth Sciences New Zealand). The database maps the active fault traces of New Zealand with fault-source characteristics such as slip rate and recurrence interval, viewable online and downloadable as spatial data. Coverage: New Zealand. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as shp, gpkg, viewer; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("GNS Science - Active Faults Database") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support seismic hazard and fault-rupture exposure studies of New Zealand infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
